message:
fix(ka-pc r3): one reservation for every new PC, owner-bound connect notices, the fence as a gate, per-PC status (Codex R1-R4)

- R1 every start beside three PCs -- an ordinary connect by hand, an automatic reconnect, a kept PC's
  preparation -- takes THE one reservation before it starts; a second candidate is refused, and so is opening
  the last standby that could make room; released on failure, cancel, an end without connecting, owner change;
  committed (PCs counted again, one standby let go) only when it connected
- R2 the ordinary connect notice carries its owner epoch and is ignored for another owner; sign-out takes the old
  owner's viewers out of the registry at once; the exit waits (bounded, 2 s, on its worker) for the output pump,
  and a connected line after that is not counted
- R3 the owner fence releases held modifiers, keys, mouse buttons, scan keys and capture FIRST, then turns input
  off; IME, deferred / restored / refused picks are dropped; the three payload posts are freed, not applied; a
  viewer whose cancel was signalled before it began opens nothing, and one called off during set-up connects not
- R4 a status about one PC (hostId) does not end another card's connecting mark
- decision 1: a press on a PC whose ordinary session is open brings its window forward ('이미 열려 있습니다');
  only an attempt still connecting is replaced
- decision 2: an automatic reconnect refused by the limit is not retried; the user is told what to do
- tests: r2b counter-cases (N6 stale op / late event of a released viewer / Activate not sent, N2 cancelled
  fourth) and r3 (five hosts: D reserved, A and E refused, A let go only after D connected, E refused with three
  open; another PC's SessionEnded keeps C connecting; the old owner's late notice; a pre-signalled cancel)
